svg.title: The boundary sum has four terms, retaining repetitions. For each fixed plaquette type and each one of its four boundary positions, the map from its base site to that bond is injective, including on the torus. Hence its total is at most 4q P F. Summing the macro term and using its column census gives X p H(p) ≤4q X F + DqNL−2 X E ≤(4q + DqN)B.
